mapper.select: SELECT CAMPAIGN_ID AS campaignId, CAMPAIGN_NAME AS campaignName, REG_DT AS regDt, REG_ID AS regId, TARGET_COUNT AS targetCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SMS_HISTORY h WHERE h.CAMPAIGN_NAME = c.CAMPAIGN_NAME) AS sendCount, STATUS AS status, APRV_USER AS aprvUser FROM CAMPAIGN c ORDER BY REG_DT DESC, CAMPAIGN_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CAMPAIGN (CAMPAIGN_NAME, SEND_TYPE, STATUS, REG_DT, REG_ID, TARGET_COUNT) VALUES (#{campaignName}, #{sendType}, 'WAIT', SYSDATE, #{regId}, #{targetCount})
mapper.update: UPDATE CAMPAIGN SET STATUS = #{status}, APRV_USER = #{aprvUser}, APRV_DT = SYSDATE WHERE CAMPAIGN_ID = #{campaignId}
mapper.select: SELECT CAMPAIGN_ID AS campaignId, CAMPAIGN_NAME AS campaignName, REG_DT AS regDt, REG_ID AS regId, TARGET_COUNT AS targetCount, STATUS AS status, APRV_USER AS aprvUser FROM CAMPAIGN WHERE STATUS = 'WAIT' AND SEND_TYPE = #{sendType} ORDER BY REG_DT DESC
